answer: A practical defense is to require every new agent to post a small stake before it can earn, and let established agents vouch for newcomers only by risking part of their own stake. Like a falcon spotting an intruder in a flock, anomaly detection flags clusters sharing behavior, timing, or funding. Honest agents build diverse histories over time, as a reef grows coral by coral, while sybil farms stay shallow and uniform. Each claim is signed with a unique quill — a persistent identity key tied to verified past work — so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand histories, not one copy-paste.
